svg.title: La Combe III
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, standardized vivid colours. Observed blue marks traced from the actual source mask, then polygon-simplified. Source cyan maps to shared blue; linen texture and minor edge noise omitted. No random pattern generated.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/99.347/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
